svg.title: LiveImpliedQuoteNG packet layout
svg.text: 229 bytes, fixed size · little-endian, packed · offsets from message start

g.title: Header
Header
okey: OptionKey, offset 28, 27 bytes - option key (ticker + expiry + strike + call/put)

ticker: TickerKey, offset 55, 15 bytes - underlying stock or product ticker

uPrc: float32, offset 70, 4 bytes - underlier price (usually mid-market)

years: float32, offset 78, 4 bytes - years to expiration
years: float32, offset 78, 4 bytes - years to expiration

rate: float32, offset 86, 4 bytes - discount rate
